note: Ingredient tokens matched against 主成分略述 from the TFDA register. Matching is by substring, because the register records salts and forms — DICLOFENAC SODIUM, IBUPROFEN LYSINE, ZOLPIDEM HEMITARTRATE — and a criterion written about diclofenac means all of them. Every token below was checked against the committed register; the count is how many active permits contain it.
matchingBias: Deliberately permissive. A false positive costs a question to a pharmacist; a false negative costs a missed harm. In a screening tool those are not symmetric, so the bias is towards raising. This is stated as a limit on every finding rather than hidden.
